title: Associate Director, Medical Affairs Congress Strategy
description:
About Us

Kardigan is a heart health company working to make cardiovascular disease preventable, curable and no longer the leading cause of death in the world. It is Kardigan ’s mission to develop multiple targeted treatments in parallel that bring people with cardiovascular diseases to the cures they deserve.

Led by Tassos Gianakakos, Jay Edelberg, M.D., Ph.D., and Bob McDowell, Ph.D., Kardigan ’s co-founders have reunited after leading MyoKardia to discover and develop mavacamten, the first cardiac myosin inhibitor, resulting in an acquisition by Bristol Myers Squibb in 2020.

We have a cutting-edge discovery and translational research platform, a pipeline of late-stage candidates, and an industry-leading team that is driven to improve the lives of patients.

At Kardigan , we are motivated by our values which guide how we work, interact, and achieve our goals. Driven by patients and their families , we are deeply committed to improving the lives of patients and prioritizing their needs above all else. We believe in being authentic -leading with truth to bring out the best in others by creating an environment where every person knows they will be fully accepted. With an eagerness to learn , we encourage the highest levels of curiosity and are open to changing our minds. We are committed to winning as a team with urgency, excellence, and intention, and support each other no matter what role we play or where we sit. Lastly, we strive to enable the impossible because patients are counting on us. We are not afraid to take risks to unlock innovation and advance scientific discoveries.

These values are the foundation of our work, empowering us to make a real difference, every day.

Position Summary

The Associate Director, Medical Affairs Congress Strategy will lead the development and execution of Kardigan 's integrated congress strategy across aortic stenosis, genetic DCM, and acute severe hypertension programs.This highly visible role will be responsible for maximizing the scientific, educational, and strategic value of congress participation through thoughtful planning, evidence dissemination, stakeholder engagement, insight generation, and omnichannel amplification. The role partners closely with Scientific Communications, Medical Directors, Clinical Development, Field Medical, Patient Advocacy, Investor Relations, and Corporate Communications to ensure congress activities support broader Medical Affairs and company objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Congress Strategy Development

• Lead development of annual and multi-year congress strategies across Kardigan 's portfolio.

• Identify and prioritize congress opportunities aligned with Medical Affairs objectives, evidence generation milestones, scientific communication priorities, and launch readiness goals.

• Define congress-specific objectives, success metrics, stakeholder engagement plans, and insight-generation priorities.

Congress Execution

Support Medical Affairs activities across the full congress lifecycle:

Pre-Congress

• Congress planning workshops

• Scientific content planning

• Medical booth strategy

• KOL engagement planning

• MSL preparation and training

• Internal leadership briefings

During Congress

• Medical booth and scientific exchange activities

• Scientific session coverage

• Competitive intelligence gathering

• Insight capture

• Executive briefings

• KOL and investigator engagements

Post-Congress

• Congress summaries and strategic assessments

• Insight synthesis and reporting

• Leadership presentations

• Recommendations for future congress activities

Congress Operations & Excellence

• Lead development and management of integrated congress planning processes, timelines, governance structures, and cross-functional execution plans.

• Develop and maintain congress dashboards, milestone tracking tools, post-congress performance metrics.

• Establish scalable operating procedures and best practices to support increasing congress complex

Job Title: Senior Product Manager - Safety
Job Location: Boston, MA
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
As the newest member of our Product Management team, you will play a crucial role in advancing Veeva Safety, an enterprise-level pharmacovigilance (drug safety) solution that manages the intake, processing, and submission of adverse events for clinical and post-market products. Your contributions will enable the Life Sciences industry as a whole to better track and inform the public about the safety risk profile of the medicines we and our loved ones often rely upon for continued health.
The ideal candidate brings a strong work ethic, a highly inquisitive mindset, a knack for dissecting complex business problems, a collaborative spirit, and a positive attitude in the face of challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers, plus our in-house industry experts and technology A-players to iteratively define a strategic road map, design & build elegant solutions, and bring rewarding solutions to market.

• Learn our industry and develop a keen understanding of our customers’ greatest pain points

• Shape the product road map, prioritizing across releases with respect to strategic and operational goals

• Design and specify accurate market-wide solutions for urgent real-world problems, in close collaboration with product development teams

• Become the subject matter expert for your areas of product ownership, providing much-needed guidance to all internal teams

• Drive product adoption, and measure the success of your solutions

Requirements

• 5+ years of product management experience with enterprise software

• 7+ years professional work experience in agile environments

• Highly motivated, self-driven individual with a strong passion for product success

• Proven experience with product design and road map planning

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or business administration

Nice to Have

• Experience in the Life Sciences industry

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

• Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

The Washington Post is seeking a Revenue Operations Manager to design and operationalize the infrastructure that powers our go-to-market organization. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, systems, analytics, and execution - enabling revenue teams to operate with greater clarity, efficiency, and accountability.
This is a dual-ownership role: approximately half your time will be spent architecting frameworks, strategies, and operational models; the other half implementing, running, and iterating on them directly. title: AI Engineer (Computer Vision and Applied GenAI)
description:
Location: Amman, Jordan. Fully remote.
Type: Full-time, permanent.
Level: Mid-level, roughly 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience.
Languages: English required. German is a strong plus.
About the role
We are looking for an AI Engineer based in Amman who will work remotely with a distributed engineering team. This is a builder role, not a research role. You will take AI capabilities from prototype to something that runs reliably in production, and you will own your work end to end: the model, the data around it, the service that serves it, and the evidence that it actually works.
The work spans two areas. On one side, computer vision and perception: camera pipelines, object detection and recognition, and inference that has to run fast and stay stable. On the other, applied generative AI: LLM-based features, retrieval, agents, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them honest. You will not be handed a narrow slice of either. You will be expected to move between them and to build the plumbing that connects them to a real product.
Tasks

• Design, train, fine-tune and evaluate models for vision tasks (detection, classification, segmentation, tracking) and integrate them into production pipelines.

• Build LLM-powered features: retrieval-augmented generation, tool-using agents, structured extraction, and the prompt and evaluation infrastructure behind them.

• Write the services around the models: APIs, data pipelines, batch and streaming jobs, storage.

• Optimise for the target hardware, including quantisation, batching, and inference on edge devices where cloud inference is not an option.

• Define and track quality metrics. Establish a baseline before claiming an improvement, and be able to show where a number came from.

• Instrument, monitor and debug models in production: drift, latency, failure modes, and the unglamorous work of finding out why a pipeline broke at 3am.

• Work directly with product and business stakeholders to turn a vague need into a scoped, measurable deliverable.

• Document what you build so that the next engineer does not have to reverse-engineer it.

Requirements

• 3 to 5 years building and shipping machine learning or AI systems in production. Personal projects and Kaggle notebooks alone will not cover this.

• Strong Python. Clean, tested, reviewable code, not notebook-only output.

• Practical depth in at least one of the two areas below, and working familiarity with the other:

•
Computer vision: PyTorch or TensorFlow, OpenCV, modern detection and segmentation architectures, dataset creation and annotation workflows.

•
Applied GenAI: LLM APIs and open-weight models, RAG, embeddings and vector stores, agent frameworks, prompt design, and systematic evaluation.

• Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, testing, CI, Docker, and comfort on the Linux command line.

• Experience deploying a model as a service and keeping it running, including cloud deployment (AWS, Azure or GCP) and basic observability.

• SQL and general data handling: you can find, clean and reason about the data before modelling it.

• Fluent written and spoken English, and the self-direction that remote work requires. You are comfortable writing things down, flagging blockers early, and working without someone checking in on you hourly.

Strong plus

•
German language skills. Part of the team and a meaningful share of the documentation, meetings and stakeholder communication are in German. Any level from solid B1 upward is a real advantage, and it will widen the scope of what you can own. It is not a hard requirement, and we will support you in improving it.

• Edge and embedded inference: NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO.

• Video streaming and industrial camera work: RTSP, GStreamer, GenICam, machine vision cameras.

• MLOps tooling: MLflow, Weights and Biases, DVC, Kubernetes, model registries.

• Experience in an industrial, robotics, IoT or B2B product environment.

title: Backend developer
description:
OverIT at a glance
OverIT is a global Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company with a strong presence in North America and Europe.
We empower organizations in the power, utility, telco, and transportation industries to manage their mission-critical infrastructures efficiently and safely through cutting-edge Field Service Management software solutions.
At OverIT , we leverage advanced technologies like ML (Machine Learning), AR (Augmented Reality), IoT (Internet of Things), and GIS (Geographic Information System) to help ensure the infrastructures essential to our daily lives are always on.
If you want to be part of a top technology brand, join us!

What you’ll do

• Design and develop high-quality backend services and REST APIs primarily using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, treating the API surface as a product used by internal teams, partners, and system integrators - not just an internal implementation detail.

• Own complex data models on Oracle, and design event-driven flows through Kafka, using Redis for caching, session state, and other performance-critical paths.

• Implement OIDC-based authentication and build resource servers that correctly validate tokens, scopes, and claims.

• Take ownership of modernizing legacy backend components: identify technical debt, architectural bottlenecks, and scalability limitations, and propose sustainable evolution strategies - moving with confidence and speed without breaking what customers depend on today.

• Publish and maintain internal libraries and shared modules other engineering teams rely on, managing versioning, breaking changes, and documentation with the same rigor as an external API.

• Build automated test suites and quality gates as a default part of delivery, not an afterthought.

• Promote secure-by-design principles and software quality standards across the development lifecycle.

• Write and run integration tests, contract tests, and performance tests as a standard part of delivery - not just unit tests - and hold your API design and code linting to a consistently enforced standard.

• Explore and apply AI-native engineering practices in your daily workflow - including agentic development tools and Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) practices - with a clear eye on token consumption and the judgment to know when to lean on AI assistance and when not to.

• Mentor engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

What you’ll need

• Solid experience in Software Engineering, with proven experience designing and implementing complex backend systems end to end.

• Deep expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring Data, and Spring Security.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (or equivalent event-streaming/messaging systems) and Redis.

• Deep knowledge of relational databases, ideally Oracle, including data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning for complex domains.

• Practical, hands-on experience implementing OIDC and building resource servers - token validation, scopes, claims-based authorization.

• A demonstrated track record of modernizing legacy backend systems with confidence and speed, not only building greenfield.

• Strong knowledge of REST API design, versioning, and building APIs that partners and system integrators can build on without things breaking underneath them.

• Genuine, hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of your daily workflow - including a track record of leveraging modern LLM-assisted development, awareness of your own token consumption, and the judgment to know when the tools help and when they don't.

• Strong, well-formed opinions on sticking to industry standards over reinventing the wheel.

• Practical, hands-on experience writing and running integration tests, performance tests, and contract tests (e.g., Pact) and disciplined use of linting/code-quality tooling.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Who is Shift?

At Shift, we’re business specialists dedicated to helping Australian SMEs take control of their cashflow, streamline trade terms and choose the right financial products.

We believe Australian businesses are the driving force behind our economy and are core to our communities. That’s why our business expertise, focus on relationships, and market-leading technology is at the core of everything we do. We’ve helped solve the credit and payment pain points for more than 30,000 businesses, providing over $6 billion in aggregate funding.

Our unique approach to product innovation combined with our collaborative culture means you can build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll be joining a diverse team of over 300 people who are always looking to deliver better outcomes for Australian businesses.

About the role:

At Shift, DevOps isn't a ticket queue. You won't be handed a change request and told to execute it, you'll be one of the people deciding how our cloud infrastructure gets built, secured and kept running. Our engineers carry real decision-making power, not just delivery responsibility, and the problems you'll be solving are ours alone to solve, because our data and decisioning capability is what makes Shift Shift. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own complex infrastructure and security work end to end.

What you'll do:

- Lead complex DevOps and security initiatives across Shift's cloud environments, from design through to delivery.

- Build, maintain and continuously improve our automated deployment pipelines using DevOps best practice.

- Drive security testing, vulnerability scanning and remediation across production, data and operational infrastructure.

- Set the standard for security best practice - policies, risk assessments, controls and processes and guide the wider infrastructure team in applying it.

- Keep a live watch on emerging security threats and industry trends, and get ahead of risk before it becomes an incident.

- Partner closely with our engineering teams to embed security into applications and tooling from the start.

- Identify infrastructure and security uplift work that's been queued for too long, and lead it end to end - we'd rather fix things properly once than patch them repeatedly.

What you'll bring:

- 5+ years in a cloud infrastructure or security-focused technology role.

- Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (IaaS and PaaS) - we run on Azure, but strong AWS experience that translates across is welcome.

- Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Bash or C#).

- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, with working knowledge of Helm.

- A solid grasp of security fundamentals (IAM, WAF, vulnerability management) backed by real implementation experience.

- Experience with CSPM/KSPM tooling, network security controls (NSGs, application gateways, firewalls, private links), and secrets management (Azure Key Vault).

- Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Enterprise, GitOps via Flux CD or Argo CD, Octopus Deploy).

- Azure Entra ID experience is preferred; exposure to Azure SQL or APM tooling like Dynatrace is a bonus.

- Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for figuring things out rather than waiting for a playbook - the tempo here is fast and the team is lean.

Key benefits:

- Collaborative teams - a flat structure means everyone can learn from colleagues and senior leaders around the business.

- Be involved - come together with all of your colleagues every 100 days to share the product and technology roadmap and business strategy.

- Flexible working environment - we’re headquartered in North Sydney with state-based workplaces and offer a flexible work policy.

- Family support - industry leading 26 weeks paid parental leave.

- Purpose built spaces within our office - designed for collaboration, brainstorming, socialising, and focused work.

title: QA & Test Automation Developer (Canada, EST, Remote)
description:
Role Overview
We are looking for a QA & Test Automation Developer to help us evolve how software quality is built, automated, and scaled across MindBridge.
Strong testing fundamentals are essential to this role. We are looking for someone who understands common testing heuristics, can identify meaningful product risks, and knows how to test and verify software beyond the obvious happy paths. You will use agentic tools to apply those skills faster and at greater scale without compromising testing depth or judgment.
You will design and maintain automated test suite, improve our quality engineering frameworks and delivery pipelines, and expand the use of AI agents within our QA processes. This includes creating, configuring and using agentic tools to accelerate test creation, analysis, failure triage, coverage assessment, and other recurring quality workflows.
As our product and software development practices become increasingly AI-native, you will also contribute to how we validate AI-powered features. Having direct experience testing AI agents, LLM-based features, or other non-deterministic systems is a strong asset.
What You Will Do
Quality engineering & automated testing
Apply strong testing fundamentals and heuristics to identify product risks, edge cases, failure modes, and gaps in expected behaviour Investigate failures and unexpected behaviour and act of them. Configure and use agentic tools with various degree of autonomy, to accelerate test creation, maintenance, analysis, failure triage, and other recurring QA activities. Advocate for testability and quality throughout the development lifecycle. Improve the reliability, performance, and scalability of our test frameworks, internal tooling, and automated quality gates. Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically and ensure appropriate validation and human oversight remain part of the testing process.
Testing AI-powered systems
Contribute to test strategies for AI-powered, LLM-based, and agentic product capabilities. Help define how non-deterministic behaviour should be evaluated, including expected behaviour, quality thresholds, regression approaches, and failure analysis. Validate areas such as model responses, tool usage, grounding, consistency, error handling, latency, and end-to-end agent behaviour where applicable.
Collaboration & continuous improvement
Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and other technical teams to make quality an integral part of software development. Share testing patterns, tools, and lessons learned, and continuously look for ways to improve testing effectiveness and delivery speed.
Required Qualifications
Strong software testing fundamentals, such as critical thinking, exploratory testing, test design, risk-based testing, common testing heuristics, and the ability to reason about customer and product impact. Hands-on experience designing and developing automated tests for modern software applications. Strong programming skills in at least one language commonly used for test automation or engineering, such as TypeScript/JavaScript or Python. Experience with modern test automation frameworks Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and incorporating automated testing into software delivery workflows. Ability to troubleshoot complex software and automated test failures across application, test, data, and infrastructure layers. Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development capabilities to automate or improve engineering and QA workflows. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across QA, Engineering, Product, and other technical teams. A continuous-improvement mindset and an interest in finding better ways to make software quality faster, more scalable, and more reliable.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based features, copilots, or autonomous or agentic systems. Experience developing evaluation frameworks or automated evaluations for non-deterministic AI

title: AML Compliance Officer, Zimbabwe
description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

Yellow Card Zimbabwe will operate as a virtual asset service provider (VASP) within the regulatory perimeter overseen by the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) at the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe and other relevant authorities. The entity is expected to process high transaction volumes and requires a locally based AML Compliance Officer to meet Zimbabwean regulatory requirements.

About the Role

We are looking for an AML Compliance Officer to serve as the local AML compliance lead and money laundering reporting officer for Yellow Card Zimbabwe. Reporting directly to the Group AMLCO & MLRO, who is based in Johannesburg, you will be the in-country subject matter expert on Zimbabwean AML law and supervisory expectations, build strong relationships with the FIU, other regulators, and banking and payment partners, and provide day-to-day compliance support in a high-volume operational environment. This role is ideal for an ambitious early-career AML professional with payments and crypto experience who thrives under pressure and wants to help build a regulated VASP from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

Zimbabwean AML Framework and Advisory

• Serve as the in-house specialist on Zimbabwean AML law, including the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act [Chapter 9:24], the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime (Virtual Asset Service Providers Registration) Regulations, 2026 (S.I. 99 of 2026), and related FIU directives, guidance, and sanctions and counter-terrorist financing requirements.

• Provide guidance and support to the Group MLRO on Zimbabwean AML obligations, FATF and ESAAMLG expectations, and the practical application of local requirements to a VASP business model.

• Translate local regulatory developments into clear, actionable advice for product, operations, customer-facing, and leadership teams.

Regulator and Partner Engagement

• Build and maintain meaningful, trust-based relationships with the FIU, the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, the Securities and Exchange Commission of Zimbabwe, banking and payment partners, and other key external stakeholders.

• Act as the entity's resident compliance contact for registration, renewal, reporting, inspections, and information requests, ensuring responses are timely, accurate, and well evidenced.

• Represent the Zimbabwean entity in routine regulator and partner interactions, in close coordination with the Group MLRO and external counsel where required.

AML Program Implementation

• Support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the entity's AML program, including policies, procedures, the institutional AML risk assessment, and the customer risk-rating methodology.

• Ensure program controls reflect Zimbabwean requirements on customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, record keeping, ongoing monitoring, and internal reporting.

• Maintain robust documentation that meets the evidentiary standards of the FIU, other regulators, banking partners, and internal and external auditors.

High-Volume Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Review and dispose of large volumes of transaction monitoring alerts in a fast-paced environment, escalating unusual or suspicious activity in line with internal procedures and regulatory expectations.

title: Design Engineer
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an outstanding engineer with a real passion for design.

Nubank's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI-assisted solutions and 30+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other.

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer - which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nubank scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

NuBrain - the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture - how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful.

A design quality measurement platform. The function knows what good looks like and has the parameters written down; scoring a flow against them is currently a manual exercise in Figma. The goal is an index - a real number for the quality of a given experience - produced by a system, not a spreadsheet.

Canonicalizing what already exists. Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

Deciding the shape of the answer. Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform - that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Architect and build the systems design at Nubank runs on - increasingly agentic ones.

- Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable.

- Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function.

- Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.

- Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you.

- Be the technical voice in a design organization - make trade-offs legible to people who don't read code.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

An outstanding, deeply experienced engineer. This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on.

A track record architecting UX systems. Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale - design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front-end infrastructure used by many teams.

A love for design that shows up in your work. Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them.

Agentic systems that help design scale. Ideally you've built them - agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do mo

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

We are building the perception stack that enables robust three/six degrees of freedom tracking, localization, and mapping in complex real-world environments. This role focuses on fusing data from cameras and inertial sensors to power SLAM / Visual-Inertial Odometry pipelines. We need an experienced perception software engineer who can create algorithms and systems that run in real time, handle uncertainty gracefully, and provide the foundation for advanced spatial intelligence on edge devices.

 

Responsibilities

- Develop and optimize sensor fusion algorithms combining IMU and camera data for SLAM and VIO (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping & Visual Inertial Odometry)

- Implement state of the art structure-from-motion techniques using different sensor modalities to generate consistent 3D reconstructions

- Evaluate algos against public benchmarks and real-world datasets

- Integrate outputs into higher-level autonomy or collaborative mapping systems (i.e. shared mapping systems)

- Collaborate with HW, robotics and platform teams to ensure end-to-end performance

- Define metrics, testing frameworks and deployment strategies for production-ready perception systems

Requirements

- BS with 10+ years of academic or industry experience in inertial sensing, computer vision, robotics or related fields with shipped or published work (or MS with 8+ yrs of the above)

- Shipped SLAM/VIO features to product

- Strong background in linear algebra, 3D geometry, VIO (probabilistic filtering and/or factor-graph optimization), and visual mapping (incremental mapping, submaps, loop closure)

- Proficient in C++/Python with experience in real-time optimization

- Proficient in using and debugging geometric optimization frameworks (e.g. Ceres, GTSAM, g2o)

- Knowledge of sensor modelling, calibration and noise characteristics

- Experience with real-time processing pipelines on embedded or edge hardware

- Preferred track record of applied research in robotics or AR/VR

MCIM is how critical facility operators make every data center stronger. With a purpose-built platform and real-time analytics, MCIM eliminates silos, removes blind spots, and ensures operators never go it alone in managing mission-critical infrastructure.
For too long, data centers have operated with fragmented tools, inconsistent workflows, and unreliable data, capping their potential. MCIM unites operations, maintenance, capital planning, and reliability intelligence into one comprehensive platform built specifically for mission-critical environments.

• No silos - one platform that unites workflows across sites and teams

• No blind spots - clean, first-party data and benchmarking that drive better decisions

• No going it alone - a consultative partner dedicated solely to data center operations

• Experience writing technical requirements, user stories, test cases and working with teams to support implementation to production quality solutions

• Demonstrated ability to establish technical leadership in fast-paced environments for critical customer implementations

title: Initiativbewerbung (m/w/d)
description:
deine aufgaben
Auch wenn wir deine Traumstelle gerade nicht ausgeschrieben haben, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung. Hierbei ist es wichtig, dass du deinen gewünschten Tätigkeitsbereich möglichst genau beschreibst. So können wir schneller entscheiden, ob wir in dem jeweiligen Team gerade Unterstützung brauchen. Darüber hinaus solltest du uns natürlich gute Argumente liefern, wie und warum du uns verstärken kannst.

Wichtig: Mit Einreichen deiner Bewerbung stimmst du automatisch zu, dass wir deine Daten bis zu 6 Monate in unserem Talent Pool speichern dürfen.

Sobald sich bei uns eine Position ergibt, für die dein Profil infrage kommt, melden wir uns bei dir! :)
dein profil
Nenne uns Dein Startdatum, Deine Gehaltsvorstellung und den Bereich, in dem du uns unterstützen möchtest.
Bitte beachte, dass wir aktuell folgende Anstellungen leider nicht anbieten können:

• Praktika jeglicher Art

• Betreuung von Abschlussarbeiten

• Anstellungen als duale Student:in

Sollte sich unser Bedarf hierbei ändern, schalten wir eine gesonderte Stellenausschreibung - daher behalte gerne unsere Karriereseite im Blick! :)
warum wir?
Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus jungen, hungrigen und motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

• Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€/Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.

•
Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt : Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget.

•
Echte Flexibilität : Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags - bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.

•
Onboarding : Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.

•
Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.

•
Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun : Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt - diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub.

•
Alle zusammen : Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work.

•
Office-Leben : Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office!

•
Wir kleiden dich ein : Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS -Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

The selected SME will provide operational insight into how the ARNG identifies, counsels, processes, and tracks Soldiers transitioning from the Active Component, Army Reserve, and Individual Ready Reserve into ARNG units. • Advise the proposal team on ARNG recruiting, retention, accession, and Reserve Component transition processes.

• Assist in developing realistic performance metrics and quality-control methods for counseling, packet processing, accessions, customer support, reporting, and vacancy management.

• Review proposal content for operational accuracy, completeness, and alignment with ARNG and Department of the Army policies and practices.

• Participate in proposal strategy sessions, solution-development meetings, and draft reviews as needed.

Required Qualifications:

• Former Army or Army National Guard service with substantial experience in recruiting, retention, career counseling, military personnel, strength management, or Reserve Component transition operations.

• Direct knowledge of ARNG recruiting and retention processes and the accession of Soldiers into Army National Guard units.

• Experience supporting Soldiers transitioning from the Active Component, Army Reserve, or Individual Ready Reserve.

• Working knowledge of Army accession, reenlistment, assignment, vacancy, and personnel-readiness processes.

• Familiarity with applicable Army and National Guard policies, including AR 601-280 and related accession and transition guidance.

• Ability to translate operational experience into clear recommendations for proposal writers and business-development personnel.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Availability to support a time-sensitive proposal effort on a part-time consulting basis.

Preferred Qualifications

description:
Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking an experienced Software Quality Assurance Engineer to independently execute and take expanded ownership of quality assurance and test automation activities on the BASIS program. Operating with minimal supervision, the QA Engineer carries direct responsibility for automated test design and delivery, test documentation ownership, defect lifecycle management, and security testing integration - all in support of the program's automation-first QA mandate. All quality assurance activities must be automated.
The selected candidate will independently manage test automation deliverables across Agile sprint cycles, contribute to QA strategy discussions, support junior engineers, and interface with developers and Government stakeholders on quality metrics and release readiness across the deployment pipeline.
This is a 100% remote role.
Test Automation Development & Strategy

• Independently design, develop, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end functional testing across the application portfolio.

• Ensure all automated test cases are executable by the end of each Agile sprint and fully integrated into the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline with minimal oversight.

• Drive and apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology - authoring test cases prior to code development and collaborating closely with software engineers to align test coverage with functional requirements.

• Lead the Test Automation State Assessment for assigned application areas; produce assessment reports with automation completion estimates.

• Own the automation of adjacent legacy test cases per Government-approved schedules to systematically expand regression coverage across the portfolio.

• Evaluate automation approaches and recommend improvements to test architecture, reusability, and pipeline integration within the Government-provided automation framework.

• Serve as a technical resource and mentor to junior QA engineers on automation best practices, test script development, and tool usage.

Test Planning & Documentation

• Develop and own Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) at the end of each development cycle/sprint, ensuring full traceability and complete testing coverage of all functional and non-functional requirements.

• Document all test activities, execution results, and defect findings within the Government-provided Test Case Management System with accuracy and completeness.

• Independently prepare Testing Reports, Release Notes (Draft and Final), and Software Version Descriptions (SVDs) per release cadence requirements.

Quality Assurance & Defect Management

• Enforce and monitor hard contractual quality thresholds with zero defects released to production.

• Lead defect triage and root cause analysis in JIRA; manage the full escalation workflow to product teams with complete documentation and submit JIRA tickets prior to all escalations.

• Own and submit weekly defect escalation reports to customers and the Government Product Owner.

Section 508 / Accessibility Testing

• Lead Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring continuous integration of accessibility compliance into the QA process.

• Own preparation of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) including test results, remediation reports, and conformance level documentation for all applicable deliverables.

• Report Section 508 compliance testing status and metrics.

Performance & Environment Testing

• Lead stress and load testing activities in the ProdSim (Production Simulation) environment; prepare and submit detailed test schedules for Government approval and execute per approved schedule.

• Coordinate and support Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities in collaboration with technical and operations teams.

• Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) of all application prior to prod

Die Schaltschränke werden extern gefertigt - Sie überwachen deren Ausführung, lesen und kontrollieren Elektroschemas und stellen die korrekte Umsetzung sicher. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern - insbesondere mit der Büchi AG in Uster - führen Sie Integrationstests durch und begleiten anschliessend Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Kundenschulung. Bei technischen Fragestellungen unterstützen Sie zudem im Troubleshooting und Support. Je nach Erfahrung und Interesse übernehmen Sie zusätzliche Aufgaben im Product Management und wirken bei der Weiterentwicklung der FlexyPlant-Lösungen mit. title: Senior Data & Integration Engineer – Incident Management Platform
Network Operator
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.

ROLE SCOPE

- Serve as the on-site Tier 3 escalation point for network and structured-cabling incidents across the site's AI infrastructure.

- Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve physical-layer faults, validate repairs, and drive rapid resolution of issues hitting customer workloads.

- Act as the escalation path for Tier 1 and 2 technicians, and partner with Network Operations on deeper investigations.

- Own structured cabling and fiber infrastructure, and interpret device-level diagnostics well enough to confirm a physical repair restored connectivity.

- Escalate out-of-scope issues to Network Operations with clear documentation, and take ownership through resolution as the sole on-site network and ICT resource.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- You've been the on-site network or cable-plant specialist in a data center, owning physical-layer troubleshooting end to end.

- You know structured cabling and fiber deeply (testing, termination, fault isolation) and you read device diagnostics well enough to validate repairs.

- You have enough network fundamentals (TCP/IP, switching, optics) to bridge cabling and the network stack.

- You operate as the sole escalation resource on-site and take incidents through to resolution.

- You document rigorously, so Network Operations can pick up cleanly when an issue exceeds on-site scope.

- Bonus: H
